soundness_flags.label: Definitions of the shell radius and finite-array decision class; all statements using R_K or decision rules
soundness_flags.one_line: \(\delta_K\) is already the supported-mixture shell radius but is reused as a Markov-kernel decision rule in \(R_K\), creating a type and notation clash that propagates to the minimax and LAN statements.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The proceedings record verifies the 2026 AISTATS publication and its claim of COT continuity under adapted Wasserstein distance plus a direct consistent nonparametric estimator and convergence rate.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper assumes bounded positive smooth densities, proves quadratic-COT stability, and gives a root-n CLT for its wavelet COT estimator; it is not a binary rare-collision theorem.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 1--3, abstract and Section 1.2; p. 5, Assumption 2.1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The manuscript claims uniformly valid dual confidence bounds under arbitrarily inaccurate outcome-distribution estimates in randomized experiments, with tightness under additional nuisance conditions.
The preprint proves a sharp minimax lower bound for multinomial uniformity testing using a conditional CLT and Poisson-mixture architecture; its target is testing rather than a two-arm COT endpoint.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Rename the shell radius to \(s_K\) (or another unused symbol) and reserve \(\delta\) for decision kernels throughout R_K, the decision classes, and the deterministic-shell question.

Add one worked numerical marked-Poisson instance, including an exact rational primal and dual certificate at a specified \((a,b,r,\alpha,\lambda)\), to make the certified-frontier contribution independently inspectable.
Strengthen the Gaussian branch by resolving the deterministic-shell LAN question or by proving a precise one-sided shell lower bound with an explicit least-favorable local flip construction.

recommended_next_step: Repair the \(\delta_K\) type clash, then advance the field-tier marked-collision frontier to Stage 0 with the deterministic-shell LAN question retained as explicit open content.
